ratios.quote: As of September 30, 2026, our Consolidated Leverage Ratio was 2.90:1.00.

parsed.notes: Leverage limit is 4.25:1.00, stepping up to 4.50:1.00 for four fiscal quarters after a material acquisition. The excerpt does not say whether a step-up applied at 2026-09-30. The minimum Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio of 3.00:1.00 applies only during a Non-Investment Grade Covenant Period. No actual coverage figure is disclosed, so it is omitted.
